common_patterns.overview: Common patterns and issues found during code reviews, with examples of problems and their correct implementations.

pattern.name: sql_injection
pattern.description: SQL injection vulnerabilities from unescaped user input
pattern.remediation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements

pattern.name: xss_vulnerability
pattern.description: Cross-site scripting from unescaped user input
pattern.remediation: Sanitize input and use safe DOM APIs

pattern.name: hardcoded_secrets
pattern.description: Credentials or API keys committed to code
pattern.remediation: Use environment variables for all secrets

pattern.name: missing_authentication
pattern.remediation: Add authentication middleware to protected routes

pattern.name: n_plus_one_query
pattern.description: Database query inside loop causing N+1 problem
pattern.remediation: Use single query with WHERE IN clause

pattern.name: missing_caching
pattern.description: Expensive operations called repeatedly without caching
pattern.remediation: Implement caching for frequently accessed data

pattern.name: memory_leak
pattern.remediation: Always remove event listeners and clean up resources

pattern.name: magic_numbers
pattern.description: Unnamed numeric constants without clear meaning
pattern.remediation: Extract magic numbers to named constants

pattern.name: code_duplication
pattern.description: Same logic repeated in multiple places
pattern.remediation: Extract common logic into reusable functions

pattern.name: deep_nesting
pattern.description: Excessive nesting making code hard to read
pattern.remediation: Use early returns and functional programming

pattern.name: inconsistent_error_handling
missing_edge_case_tests
pattern.remediation: Test boundary values, nulls, and edge cases

pattern.name: testing_implementation_details
pattern.description: Tests coupled to implementation rather than behavior
pattern.remediation: Test public interfaces, not private implementation

pattern.name: no_async_error_handling_tests
pattern.remediation: Always test error paths and edge cases

pattern.name: feature_commit
pattern.template:
feat(user-authentication): add login and registration endpoints
- Implement JWT-based authentication - Add user registration with email verification - Include password reset functionality
Closes #123

pattern.name: bugfix_commit
pattern.template:
fix(api): handle null response in user endpoint
- Prevents crash when API returns null - Add proper error handling - Update tests to cover null case
Fixes #456

pattern.name: refactor_commit
pattern.template:
refactor(auth): extract session management to separate module
- Move session logic to dedicated class - Improve testability of authentication flow - No functional changes
Related to #789

pattern.name: docs_commit
pattern.template:
docs(api): update authentication endpoint documentation
- Add examples for new login flow - Document error response formats - Update API specification
See #101

pattern.name: test_commit
pattern.template:
test(auth): add tests for session timeout
- Test session expiration handling - Verify token refresh flow - Add coverage for edge cases
Related to #202
